# Misha Lubich

> Personal site of Misha Lubich, a Staff AI Engineer at EchoStar, previously Apple, Walmart and Lawrence Berkeley National Lab.

Misha builds production AI systems: machine learning, MLOps, large language models, agents and full-stack web apps. The site has his portfolio, consulting, publications, a blog, free AI tools, an LLM price comparison and small LLM-themed browser games.

## Pages

- [Home](https://www.mishalubich.com/): portfolio, experience, projects, skills, publications, contact
- [Blog](https://www.mishalubich.com/blog): articles on AI engineering
- [Tools](https://www.mishalubich.com/tools): AI project cost estimator and system prompt linter
- [LLM prices](https://www.mishalubich.com/llm-prices): model pricing comparison
- [Games](https://www.mishalubich.com/games): LLM-themed browser games
- [RSS feed](https://www.mishalubich.com/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://www.mishalubich.com/sitemap.xml)
